The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

# docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured 0.9 s at 100 lines, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.
# Inventory reservation load test (2026-09-08)
Run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 (reservations are now batched). p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0.5 s |
| 100 | 0.9 s |
| 150 | 1.7 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

steps.reasoning_content: The ADR still lists 60 from the 2024 load test, but the reservation service was replaced in 2026-09 and the new test gives 0.9 s at 100 lines, so 100 is right. I'm marking the old ADR as superseded and adding the decision record.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: 100
status: final
evidence: [docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md, docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md, config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md]
---
Two values existed. 60 came from ADR 0007, chosen because the 2024-08 load test showed p99 reservation latency of 3.9 s at 80 lines and 7.2 s at 100, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. 100 is in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md, set after the reservation service was replaced and batched on 2026-09-01. The 2026-09 load test measures 0.9 s p99 at 100 lines (1.7 s at 150), within the timeout. The 2024 measurements no longer describe the system, so 100 wins; ADR 0007 was stale and is marked superseded.
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)","Status: Superseded by docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md (limit is now 100; the 2024 latency figures predate the 2026-09 reservation service replacement)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git add -A; git commit -qm "docs: reconcile cart item limit at 100, supersede ADR 0007

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"; git status --short

steps.message:
The cart item limit is now 100 everywhere. I committed the changes but haven't pushed or commented on issue #12.

- **Cause:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` said 100, but ADR 0007 still said 60.
- **Why 100:** The ADR's 60 came from the 2024 load test, which showed 3.9 s p99 at 80 lines against the 2.0 s checkout timeout. The reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01, and the new load test measures 0.9 s at 100 lines, so the 2024 numbers no longer apply.
- **Changes:**
  - I marked ADR 0007 as superseded.
  - I added `docs/decisions/cart-item-limit.md` recording the decision.
- **Commits:** There are two, because the first command partly failed (no `python3`). The first holds the decision record and the second the ADR status edit.

I didn't run any tests; the changes are docs only.
